title: Factory test suite fails when Python writes bytecode caches during the run
description:
On Linux arm64 with Python 3.13.5, ./.factory/scripts/test reports 12 failures (context export, process check record-content/CLI and task archive tests) because the helpers' __pycache__ directories appear between the before/after tree or git status snapshots the tests compare. With PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 all 197 tests pass. Pre-existing harness behaviour, not caused by the task diff. Next: make the configured test command or the fixtures ignore bytecode caches (e.g. set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE or exclude __pycache__ from snapshots).
